catalog.title: Ingersoll Compact Tractors 112B, 114B, 116B Parts Catalog 8-3100
catalog.structure: PDF p1 cover, p2 paint and oil list + product identification numbers (ID table, printed page 1), p3 general information + alphabetical index (with a generic indented-description example table from another book, not transcribed), p4-31 diagram/table spreads (printed pages 5-59, odd pages carry the tables), p32-33 numerical index (printed pages 60-63)

relations.note: 8-2992's 112 has the same engine (C30146 281707-0135-01); its serial window overlaps the 112B break, so the finder asks the customer (serial matching rule step 3).

validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table read by eye from 200-dpi crops (two table pages per image at 0.7x, 15 images, plus full-resolution zooms); tesseract only as a draft. Numerical index read by eye at full resolution (8 quarter-page images) in sort order beside the expected index generated from the transcription.
validation.refContinuity: Refs not printed: carburetor 114B/116B ref 9; blower housing refs 4 and 20; hood ref 23; electrical hardware ref 13 (index lists none of these). Travel control ref 19 is not printed in the table but the index lists 192- 19 at 47/19: added as an index-only row. Unnumbered rows kept and flagged: gasket set/kit rows (pp5, 7), C28030 fuel-line insulation, carburetor overhaul kits and both carburetor assemblies (p15), C27418 starting motor (p51), C28962 clip (p57), C32178 headlight assembly (p57). Paint and oil restarts at 1 for the OIL list.
validation.quantities: Every row has a qty except the p7 gasket kit C27335, carburetor 112B ref 7 (pin, float hinge) and the index-only travel ref 19. UAR on 12 rows. REQ'D printed about half a row low on steering gear (p33), transaxle shifter/counter shaft (p43), differential (p45) and drive belts (p49): mapped in sequence, counts equal, flagged 'inferred qty'.
validation.numericalIndex: Index (pp60-63, ~800 entries; hardware printed with leading zeros, e.g. 011- 312) compared column by column in both directions. All transcribed rows appear except the whole Headlight and Rear Reflector table (p57 lower half), which the index omits. Index differs from the table (table kept, row flagged): C25745 for C25742 (13/13), C27370 for C27270 (21/19), C29304 for C29314 (27/1), 123- 311 for 132-311 (35/24); index prints G25746 for C25746 (5/32). Index-only entry 192- 19 at 47/19 added as a row. Paint and oil are not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs BR numbers stored bare (391406), Case C numbers closed up (C30843), hardware codes stored 'NNN-NNNN' (187-1508); footnote marks (*, **, †, ††) dropped from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted. Doubtful hardware prefixes kept as printed and flagged: 11-312, 13-624, 13-628, 83-55. 'C- 30435' (p13 ref 34) stored C30435, flagged. NSS rows store partNo NSS with the 'use ...' text in desc/flags.
